ops.text: At distance five, color-code cultivation reaches far lower accepted errors at the price of a larger code and many more postselected checks; the square-octagon cultivation circuit of Ref. [⟦new.B1⟧], for instance, reports about $4.3\times 10^{-10}$ at the same $p$.
